edit.description: The declared one home (its own header: "one home for scaffolding … every suite would otherwise carry its own copy of") gains each folded helper under one doc comment: `fresh_clause`, `workspace` (a `<tmpdir>/.temper` pair), `messages(&[Diagnostic]) -> Vec<&str>`, the manifest-shaped `member(serde_json::Value) -> Features`, `hook_kind_facts`, the layout trio `layout_kind`/`field_region`/`layout_member`, `root_reachable_binding`, and the bare rule row two suites spell `common::kind_facts("rule", ".claude/rules", "*.md")` — deliberately format-less and unit-shape-less, so it must NOT collapse into the existing `rule_kind_facts` (yaml-frontmatter, `file`) and its name has to say which row it is. `feature(id)` is already a one-line alias over this module's `features`, so its two copies delete rather than move. A folded name that would read ambiguously beside an existing sibling (`clause`, `features`, `mention`, `kind_facts`) is renamed at the fold. The module carries no blanket dead-code allow by design, and every folded helper has at least two callers, so nothing lands unused under `clippy -D warnings`.

Drops `fresh_clause` (:38), `workspace` (:79) and `hook_kind_facts` (:634) — 46 call sites, which reach the shared names through `use crate::common::{…}` (the style ten suites already use), so no call site moves.

Drops `fresh_clause` (:40), 8 call sites. Its copy's doc carries a per-suite intent commitment — the guard's enforcement mode is a separate decision from the clause — which belongs to `the_guards_enforcement_mode_decides_a_guarded_write_whatever_the_fresh_clause_binds` (:2318), not to the shared helper: move that sentence onto the test, never into `common`.
Drops `fresh_clause` (:29), 3 call sites; already imports `use crate::common::tmpdir`, so the name joins that list.
Drops `fresh_clause` (:20) and the bare `rule_kind` (:30), 6 call sites.
Drops `fresh_clause` (:25), the bare `rule_kind` (:39) and `feature` (:263, the alias over `common::features`), 11 call sites.
Drops `fresh_clause` (:27), `layout_kind` (:37), `field_region` (:56), `layout_member` (:67) and `feature` (:310) — the widest copier at 28 call sites.
Drops `layout_kind` (:30), `field_region` (:39) and `layout_member` (:50), 13 call sites; its divergent `edge` builder (:64) stays local.

Drops `hook_kind_facts` (:97), 2 call sites. Its divergent sibling `timed_hook_kind_facts` (:111) — a lifted `timeout` beside `matcher` — stays local and struct-updates off the shared builder, exactly as it struct-updates off `common::kind_facts` today.
Drops `workspace` (:305), 5 call sites; already imports `use crate::common::write_plugin_json`.
Drops `member` (:22) and `messages` (:78), 15 call sites; its `clause`/`contract`/`declares`/`closes` builders differ from their same-named siblings elsewhere and stay local.
Drops `member` (:26) and `messages` (:57), 19 call sites; its `contract` and `findings` builders differ from their same-named siblings and stay local.
Drops `root_reachable_binding` (:130), 2 call sites; already imports `use crate::common::{check_harness, write_settings}`.

summary: Eleven fixture helpers are copy-pasted across fifteen integration suites — 28 byte-identical definitions, `fresh_clause` six times — where `tests/it/common` is the declared one home.

tests.asserts: the 46 call sites of the folded `workspace`/`fresh_clause`/`hook_kind_facts` pass unchanged against the shared definitions
the layout fixture trio drives from `common` with no call-site edit, and `layout_prose_import.rs`'s 28 sites do the same
`member`/`messages` resolve to the shared definitions, as do `closed_keys.rs`'s and `shape_predicate.rs`'s

acceptance: `cargo test` green over the one `it` binary with each folded helper defined exactly once, in `tests/it/common/mod.rs`; `rg -n '^fn (fresh_clause|workspace|messages|member|feature|rule_kind|hook_kind_facts|layout_kind|field_region|layout_member|root_reachable_binding)\(' tests/it/*.rs` returns nothing outside `common/mod.rs` bar a body the commit body names as identical only by coincidence; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` green.
notes: Census taken by comparing definition bodies on disk: 11 names, 28 definitions, 15 suites. Fold only where both callers want the same fixture — a body identical by coincidence stays put and the commit body names it. No new assertion is possible or added: the 168 existing call sites are the pin, and a recurrence gate over suite sources is a separate design question. scoped at cfd5591e
